Card Q&A.q: Can this card's inherited effect return this card to its owner's hand?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you must return a card to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: When activating this card’s inherited effect, am I required to return a level 4 or lower Digimon card from my trash to my hand?

Inherited Effect: [On Deletion] Return 1 purple level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash to your hand.
